items.text: Map Panel

Your goal is to defeat the Boss; study the map to plan your route.

At first only the Boss cell is revealed; you can unlock the information of adjacent cells.
Map Movement

Click the up / down / left / right arrows to move to an adjacent cell.

If the cell you reach is not empty, its content will trigger.
Step Limit
Once the number of cleared levels reaches the limit, every cell turns into a Boss cell and you are forced into the Boss fight. Prepare before that happens.
Player Info
The top-left corner shows your HP, buffs and Gold.
Enemy Info

This is the enemy. The icon and number above it show its intent for this turn.

If there are several enemies, click one to focus it. (The default target is the leftmost enemy.)
Basic Arrows

This is your hand: the arrows you draw each turn appear here.

This is the play area: the arrows you are about to play or redraw appear here.

Arrows come in four directions: up, down, left and right. Each arrow triggers its own basic effect when read, and then item matching happens.
Item Slots

This is your item bar. When the arrow combination in the play area matches an item recipe, that item's effect triggers.

Starting from the same arrow, if several items qualify, their effects trigger in order from left to right.

You can drag items to change their order.
Play Limit

The number between the play area and the item bar is your play limit.

Changing or playing arrows uses up your play limit, and once it runs out you cannot play any more.

Click an arrow in your hand to move it to the play area; click an arrow in the play area to cancel playing it.
Playing Arrows
Click an arrow in your hand to move it to the play area, then click “Act” at the bottom-right to confirm and end your turn.
Redraw

When you draw arrows you do not want, click the “Redraw” button to redraw them.

Your redraw count resets to 1 at the start of each turn; some effects can raise it temporarily or permanently.

Click arrows in your hand to move them to the play area, then click the bottom-left button to redraw every arrow in the play area.
Battle Reward
Winning a battle grants 2 Gold, and you may then pick 1 of 3 extra rewards.
Buying in the Shop

In the shop you can buy new items and arrows, or delete arrows you no longer need.
To leave the shop, click the wide red arrow at the bottom of the screen.
Event Options

Each event offers several options, chosen by playing the matching arrow combination; if nothing matches, the option without a requirement triggers automatically.

Click arrows in your hand to move them to the play area, then click “Act” to confirm your option.

Event draws come from your deck, so if you cannot build the combination you want you can redraw as well.
